buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last

three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 5. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be as given in specifications from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 9. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Procurement of 6-Stack, 06-Station Multi-Station Gym Equipment Purchaser: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT), Bengaluru Campus

1. Background and Purpose RGIPT Bengaluru Campus is committed to promoting physical fitness, health and the overall well-b eing of students and campus residents. To strengthen the existing sports and fitness facilities, the Institute proposes to procure 6-Stack, 06-Station Multi-Station Gym Equipment for the camp us gymnasium. The equipment shall enable multiple users to perform different strength-training exercises simulta neously, improve the utilisation of gym facilities and encourage regular physical activity among st udents and other eligible campus users. 2. Scope of Supply The supplier shall provide, deliver, install and commission the following equipment: S. N Description Quant o. ity 1 6-Stack, 06-Station Multi-Station Gym Equipment, complete with accessories, w 01 Uni eight stacks and installation t The quoted price shall include transportation, loading, unloading, installation, commissioning, dem onstration and training, wherever applicable. 3. Technical Specifications The equipment shall meet the following minimum technical requirements: A. Certification and General Specifications Parameter Required Specification Type of Usage Class S. Class Number of Exer 06 stations for concurrent use by 06 users cise Stations Types of Exerci Lat Pull Down, Mid Row, Multi Press, Leg Curl, Leg Extension, Functional Train ses er, Chin Dip, Bicep Curl (Cable), Butterfly/Rear Deltoid B. Any variation shall require prior approval of the purchaser. E. Warranty and Installation

Parameter Required Specification Structural Frame Warranty 7 years (excluding coating) Warranty for Bearings, Guide Rods, Pulleys and Cable 3 years s Installation at User Premises Yes Training to Technical Staff Yes 4. Certification and Supporting Documents The bidder shall submit the following documents along with the technical bid: 1. Manufacturer's technical datasheet/catalogue clearly indicating compliance with the prescri bed specifications. 2. Valid test report/certificate demonstrating compliance with IS 17801 (Part 1)/ISO 20957, as applicable. 3. Documentary evidence of the proposed equipment's Class S usage classification. 4. Manufacturer's warranty confirmation covering the specified components and periods. 5. Details of the manufacturer/OEM and model number. 6. Declaration confirming availability of installation, commissioning and training support. The purchaser reserves the right to verify the authenticity of certificates and technical documents submitted by the bidder. 5. Delivery, Installation and Commissioning 1. The equipment shall be delivered to RGIPT Bengaluru Campus. 2. The supplier shall complete delivery, installation and commissioning within the delivery peri od specified in the GeM contract. 3. Installation shall include proper assembly, alignment, adjustment and functional testing of a ll six stations. 4. The supplier shall provide a demonstration and basic operational training to the designated t echnical staff. 5. All transportation, installation and commissioning expenses shall be borne by the supplier. 6. Inspection and Acceptance 1. The equipment shall be inspected by the authorised representatives of RGIPT Bengaluru Ca mpus. 2. Acceptance shall be subject to verification of technical specifications, quantity, accessories, weight stacks, safety features and warranty documents. 3. All six stations shall be demonstrated in working condition before final acceptance. 4. Any defective, damaged or non-conforming component shall be replaced by the supplier wit hout additional cost. 5. Final acceptance shall be issued only after satisfactory installation and commissioning. 7. Payment Terms Payment shall be processed as per the GeM contract conditions after successful delivery, installati on, commissioning, inspection and acceptance of the equipment, along with submission of the pre scribed invoice and supporting documents. 8. Warranty and After-Sales Service 1. The supplier shall provide a 7-year warranty on the structural frame, excluding coating. 2. Bearings, guide rods, pulleys and cables shall carry a minimum 3-year warranty. 3. Warranty shall cover manufacturing defects and defective components as per the applicable warranty terms. 4. The supplier shall provide necessary after-sales support and replace defective parts covered under warranty without additional cost.

9. General Terms and Conditions 1. The bidder shall quote for the complete equipment as a single functional unit. 2. Partial supply or supply of equipment not meeting the prescribed specifications shall not be accepted. 3. The supplier shall ensure compliance with applicable safety and quality standards. 4. All accessories necessary for the proper functioning of the equipment shall be included in th e quoted price. 5. The purchaser reserves the right to verify the technical credentials and documents submitte d by the bidder. 6. All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the GeM General Terms and Conditions and the applicable procurement rules. 7. In case of any discrepancy, applicable GeM terms and conditions shall prevail. Purchaser: Administration Department Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT) Bengaluru Campus .
